classification: Windows preparation-only adaptation; estimator patch and published package unchanged
changes: Verify tar member modes and blob identities against literal Git before extraction; verify extracted paths/content with preserved tar modes, not Windows execute bits
Use .exe filename consistently for Windows PE output
unified_diff:
--- published/mr09_prepare_estimator.py
+++ task-private/mr09_prepare_estimator_windows.py
@@ -51,7 +51,29 @@
     source = output / 'source'
     source.mkdir()
     archive = subprocess.check_output(['git', '--no-replace-objects', '-C', str(upstream), 'archive', PIN])
+    archive_modes = {}
+    archive_blobs = {}
     with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as stream:
+        for item in stream.getmembers():
+            if item.isdir():
+                continue
+            if not item.isfile() or item.name in archive_modes:
+                raise RuntimeError('unexpected or repeated archive member')
+            data = stream.extractfile(item).read()
+            archive_modes[item.name] = '100755' if item.mode & 0o111 else '100644'
+            archive_blobs[item.name] = hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(data)).encode() + b'\0' + data).hexdigest()
+        literal_tree = subprocess.check_output(['git', '--no-replace-objects', '-C', str(upstream), 'ls-tree', '-rz', PIN])
+        literal = {}
+        for item in literal_tree.split(b'\0'):
+            if not item:
+                continue
+            meta, name = item.split(b'\t', 1)
+            mode, kind, blob = meta.decode().split()
+            if kind != 'blob' or mode not in ('100644','100755'):
+                raise RuntimeError('unsupported upstream tree entry')
+            literal[name.decode()] = (mode,blob)
+        if {name:(mode,archive_blobs[name]) for name,mode in archive_modes.items()} != literal:
+            raise RuntimeError('archive mode/blob inventory mismatch')
         stream.extractall(source, filter='data')
     # Archive attributes can omit or substitute leaves; verify every literal
     # pinned Git blob and executable bit before applying the derivative.
